Class ImageGenerationConfig

java.lang.Object
com.github.copilot.rpc.ImageGenerationConfig
@CopilotExperimental public class ImageGenerationConfig extends Object
Experimental. This API may change or be removed in a future release. Opt in to image generation through an authorized Copilot image model. Omission disables on create/cold resume and preserves resident resume state. Not persisted: re-supply after runtime restart. Policy, permissions, offline mode, and tool filters still apply. BYOK image generation is not supported.

    • setSaveToDisk

      public ImageGenerationConfig setSaveToDisk(Boolean saveToDisk)
      Experimental. Saves generated and edited images under the session-state directory's images folder and gives the model each path as a saved_to: line in the tool result. Defaults to true; set false to opt out. Subagents follow their parent's value unless they set their own. A failed save still returns the image. Sessions without a local session-state directory never save. Re-supply after cold resume. Does not enable image generation.
      Parameters:
      saveToDisk - the preference, or null when unset
      Returns:
      this config for method chaining
